Thick_Double_Winter_Coat.description: This dense, snow-white fur coat, perfectly adapted to the harsh arctic climate, not only serves as a formidable barrier against the biting cold but also enhances the wearer's constitution, allowing them to endure the harshest winters with unwavering resilience.

Wirehaired_Brush_Defensive_Pelt.description: This dense, wirehaired pelt not only serves as a natural armor, enhancing the terrier's resilience with a sleek, protective layer that adds two points to its natural defenses, but also grants the creature the innate ability to block incoming attacks with its bristly fur, deflecting harm with an almost supernatural ease.

Sleek_Water_Repellent_Hide.description: This sleek, water-repellent hide glistens with an iridescent sheen, perfectly adapted for aquatic pursuits, while its fur remains dry and buoyant, granting swiftness and agility in both water and on land.

Cryptic_Mottle_Camouflage_Fur.description: This thick, mottled fur coat, reminiscent of the African wild dog, is not only a marvel of evolutionary adaptation but also a masterful disguise, blending seamlessly with the shadows to enhance stealth, while its subtle elegance also subtly boosts charisma.

Loose_Wrinkled_Defensive_Skin.description: This creature's skin is a marvel of defensive adaptation, loose and wrinkled like ancient parchment, providing a natural buffer against physical impacts and granting an innate resilience that allows it to shrug off the worst of attacks while enhancing its constitution and granting resistance to being knocked back.

Spined_Hellhound_Bristles.description: The Spined_Hellhound_Bristles is a jagged, crimson-furred integument that bristles with sharp, venomous spikes, each one a testament to the creature's mutant heritage and formidable nature, granting enhanced strength and charisma while bestowing the wearer with the skills to cause bleeding and intimidate foes.

Mange_Ridden_Necrotizing_Pelt.description: This gruesome pelt, once the thick fur of a noble canine, now pulses with an unsettling vitality, its matted and rotting coat harboring a cloud of poisonous miasma that spreads fear and decay to all who draw near.

Glandular_Musk_Emitting_Hide.description: The Glandular Musk Emitting Hide is a thick, dense fur coat that radiates an overpowering scent, capable of both attracting and repelling other creatures, making it a formidable yet cumbersome layer of protection for canines.

Armored_Chitinous_Plating.description: The Armored Chitinous Plating is a thick, interlocking layer of chitin that not only serves as a robust shield against physical attacks but also slightly restricts the agility of its canine mutant host, granting it the ability to parry blows with its rigid exoskeleton.

Symbiotic_Bioluminescent_Fungus_Pelt.description: Enveloped in a thick pelt of bioluminescent fungi, this canine-like entity radiates a eerie, otherworldly glow that betrays its presence while bestowing upon it a profound wisdom, though at the cost of stealth and agility.
